name: When do I need professional interior storm damage repair instead of a simple cosmetic fix?

mainEntity.name: When do I need professional interior storm damage repair instead of a simple cosmetic fix?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt repair is critical when you notice sagging or stained drywall, peeling paint, damp insulation, warped flooring, or persistent musty odors after a weather event. Water from storm-damaged roofs or siding often travels along interior framing before pooling on ceilings or inside wall cavities. If you see cracks spreading along wall seams or spongy baseboards, hidden water intrusion has likely occurred. Addressing these signs early prevents framing rot, drywall degradation, and widespread finish repairs throughout the living area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional if you spot sagging drywall, discolored ceilings, soft framing, warped baseboards, or persistent damp odors after severe weather.
